errors.evidence: According to the reference description, the 'Other' category is a white segment, not pale blue. The image shows it as a distinctly lighter/white segment compared to the other blue slices.

The reference description notes that sectors are arranged in descending order based on their size in anti-clockwise direction. The machine-generated description vaguely says 'arranged roughly from the largest shares to smaller ones around the circle' without specifying the anti-clockwise direction.
The description does not mention that labels are placed outside the slices, only that percentages are inside the slices. The reference explicitly notes 'the labels are outside the slices.'
